payload.body: CANON WRITE, LIVE ON SAVE, NOW: landing vc's 0510 bank into lib/templates/hooks/pre-commit.sh (blob 02fc377b7, patch-id d619f35be, +31 -2). This file is read live from the install by EVERY estate's gate on this machine, so the change takes effect the moment it is written, not at commit. WHAT CHANGES: the rc-0 success line gains a clause -- 'N of N declared language(s) enforced (...), K rule(s) disabled by this project.' Additive to one printed line; no verdict, no exit code and no blocking behaviour moves. Judged by dc against the bytes that land, with the non-zero path driven end to end against a planted project for the first time.
